study.title: Kathmandu Valley urban pilot, Nepal
study.question: Are matched-season Sentinel-2 pairs available over a bounded inner-city pilot, and does bare soil / construction confusion threaten a built-up signal?
limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
NDBI is a feature, not a building label.
Agriculture/forest boundary ambiguity.

aoi.kind: small bounded pilot window inside the urban core
aoi.boundary_source: Manually placed; not a municipal boundary.

can_conclude: Candidate built-up spectral signal (NDBI) and vegetation/water context between matched-season 2020 and 2025 observations.
Where the built-up signal and the vegetation signal disagree — the inspection panel for bare-soil, construction-site and riverbed confounders.
cannot_conclude: Buildings constructed, impervious area in hectares, or population change: NDBI is a spectral feature, not a building detector.
Any classifier accuracy: no independent reference labels exist for this AOI (docs/M2_LABEL_FEASIBILITY.md), so the supervised path stays blocked.

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2020-2026), processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data). DEM: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA/DLR) where included. Event context: NDRRMA (2025) and ICIMOD (2026) situation reporting, cited as external literature, not project measurements.

area_cross_check.note: the raster area differs from the polygon area by boundary rasterisation only; hectares and km2 are converted from projected square metres, not from degrees

limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
NDBI is a feature, not a building label.
Agriculture/forest boundary ambiguity.
The following indices use 20 m SWIR bands resampled to the 10 m analysis grid and contain no genuine 10 m SWIR detail: ndbi.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.
summary.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data, processed by ESA; L2A products distributed by the Element 84 Earth Search STAC catalogue (AWS Open Data).

method.source: frozen M1 difference rasters + common-valid masks
method.threshold_rule: recorded primary threshold of each index (|Δ| ≥ t)
method.geometry: rasterio.features.shapes on the native UTM grid, projected to WGS84 (pyproj); no hand-drawn geometry
method.area_convention: pixel count × pixel area on the projected analysis grid

interpretation.title: ▼ Candidate NDBI decrease · Region 01
interpretation.observed_measurement: Mean ΔNDBI -0.389 index units (median -0.413 index units) at the recorded threshold |Δ| ≥ 0.15; 150 px = 1.50 ha = 0.34 % of the 43,728-px shared-valid footprint.
interpretation.meaning: A NDBI decrease here marks where the later composite reads lower in NDBI. For NDBI this is a candidate built-up/impervious-surface signal — NOT a building detector; bare soil and construction sites raise NDBI the same way.
explanations: New or extended impervious surfaces (candidate built-up change).
Bare soil, construction sites or cleared ground between the windows.
Vegetation loss on the ΔNDVI counter-evidence panel.
interpretation.evidence_strength: Shared-valid coverage for this comparison is 100.00 % of the AOI (43,728 px). The region is a connected 150-px component at a stated threshold — adjacent pixels are not independent observations, so no significance is claimed. Candidate spectral signal with stated thresholds, not independently verified change.
cannot_conclude: That individual buildings were newly constructed (10 m pixels cannot resolve buildings).
Verified urban expansion without independent evidence.

masking_and_cloud_limitations: Bare soil, construction sites and dry riverbeds mimic built-up spectra.
NDBI is a feature, not a building label.
Agriculture/forest boundary ambiguity.
The following indices use 20 m SWIR bands resampled to the 10 m analysis grid and contain no genuine 10 m SWIR detail: ndbi.
Composites are robust within-period summaries of a few observations, not a dense time series; inter-annual change is represented by two period composites only.
Index differences are candidate spectral signals. They are not verified deforestation, wetland loss, construction, glacier damage or any other causal land-cover label.
Cloud, shadow and saturated-pixel exclusion relies on the provider SCL product; terrain shadow is not independently re-derived.
Surface reflectance is the provider L2A product; no independent atmospheric correction is performed.
Areas are planimetric on the documented projected grid; UTM scale distortion at this AOI is small but nonzero.
confounding_factors: New or extended impervious surfaces (candidate built-up change).
Bare soil, construction sites or cleared ground between the windows.
Vegetation loss on the ΔNDVI counter-evidence panel.
